Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behaviour. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands run, their outcomes and any checks that remain unperformed. Distinguish local CPU tests,
visual inspection and historical GPU evidence. For a figure change, include its caption, input hashes and
previews at the intended display size, generated from the documented inputs for the affected figure.

## Scientific and compatibility impact

State whether this changes data, splits, response units, cliff labels, model settings, stopping, official
state selection, aggregation, dependencies, paths or schemas. Link the documented rationale when applicable.

## Review checks

- [ ] Historical results, task records and provenance remain intact.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and meaningful tests or visual checks have been updated.
- [ ] New prose uses British English; external identifiers and schema keys are preserved.
- [ ] Comments explaining scientific decisions, units, limitations and compatibility remain useful.
- [ ] Included material has been reviewed for publication; private settings and correspondence are excluded.

If a check does not apply, explain briefly. Protocol changes and training dependency upgrades require
separate scientific review; a passing CPU workflow does not establish GPU equivalence.
